Color/material-only faithful edit of the FIRST attached ONE complete 2D Tomb Guardian sprite. Keep the ONE long narrow dark RED-BLACK weapon shaft on the far anatomical LEFT, partially occluded by the body; remove exaggerated bright glowing red bulbs/highlight emission, keep only restrained weathered dark-red accents in its nearly black shaft. Keep pale gray irregular jagged heavy cluster shape and size exactly. The existing small upper metal pommel should be neutral steel/charcoal, not gold. Do not add an axe, sword, large new mace or separate staff.

Keep exact passing pose: far anatomical LEFT knee/boot raised, nearer RIGHT boot planted rounded heel. Do not exchange legs.

Do not change the pose while correcting color/material. No background, ground shadow, text, outlines, guides, effects or invented ornaments. Newly authored 2D motion, not extracted animation. Original pose identity/gait/feet must remain the same.
